name: POST /api/leads - Capture a lead through the ProjexCloud lead-capture SDK
description: Captures an inbound lead for an authenticated caller - the application UI and server-to-server API integrations. Creating a row at the collection root, so it answers 201. The handler writes the local projection first and then asserts the lead upstream through the ProjexCloud sdk-lead-capture gateway using the new row id as the idempotency key; asserted_upstream reports whether that assertion landed, so a capture is never lost when the gateway is briefly unreachable. name, email and source are required: a capture missing any of them cannot be routed or attributed. origin_class defaults to first_party_declared. QA: depends on register and login; present the captured session token as a bearer. AUTO-ROUTING AT INTAKE: the handler routes the lead immediately after persisting it, so the response carries the owner and the started clock rather than a pre-routing snapshot, and `routed` reports whether an owner was assigned. A routing failure does NOT fail the capture - the lead is already durable and appears in the Capture Inbox as unowned for the zero-orphan sweep (POST /api/leads/route-unowned) to pick up.

testCases.name: Capture a lead from a web form

errorCases.when: name or email is missing, email is malformed OR longer than 255 characters (the leads.email column width - unbounded input would reach the database and surface as a 500), source is not one of the fourteen channels, or origin_class is not one of the eight origin classes
the Authorization header is absent, or present without a Bearer token
the bearer token fails verification or has expired
